status: Current 7.2 season snapshot; boss data manually referenced from Stygian.moe; not a live HoYoverse API.
sourceType: Manually maintained reference snapshot. Stygian.moe lists encounter data and community clears; this app does not fetch a live boss API. HP values are Fearless V (Lv 105) and Dire VI (Lv 110). Team suggestions are theorycraft starting points, not verified optimal teams.
rules: This calculator models the listed Fearless V (Lv 105) and Dire VI (Lv 110) HP values.
Team guides are suggestions, not rankings; account builds, rotations, and challenge rules change results.
A verified reward table is not included in the available source data.

bosses.name: Wavebinder: Stormfang

phases.name: Regular · before Valiant Assault
phases.description: 10% RES to most damage types; Hydro 70%, Electro −10%.

bosses.note: Electro is the key answer to Courage and Valiant Assault. Hydro is heavily resisted throughout.
mechanics: About 10 seconds after combat begins, then roughly every 20 seconds, it drinks for 3 seconds and gains 600 Courage. Stellar Glimmer during the drink reduces this to 540; the next drink has a 50% chance to be a 189-Courage small sip.
Electro damage outside the drink drains Courage. At 600 Courage it gains a shield equal to its max HP and enters Valiant Assault.
During Valiant Assault, Courage drains by 15 per second; Electro damage drains it more efficiently.
When Courage reaches zero or the shield breaks, the boss exits the phase. Breaking the shield causes backlash based on absorbed damage, capped at 15% max HP. Resistances return to regular values.

traits.name: Courage Against the Cold: Hearty Draught
traits.description: The boss periodically drinks to gain Courage. Applying Radiance: Stellar Glimmer while it drinks reduces the Courage gained. Electro damage also drains Courage; Electro Stellar Glimmer drains more.

traits.name: Valiant Assault
traits.description: At full Courage the boss gains a large shield and sharply raises resistance to all elements except Electro. Courage drains over time and Electro drains it faster. Leaving the state causes backlash damage.

guide.overview: Use repeated Electro application to drain Courage. Hydro RES is 70% normally and 130% during Valiant Assault; Electro remains the least resisted option.
strategy: Keep an Electro damage source active between drinks to drain Courage.
If your roster can trigger Stellar Glimmer, time it with the drink animation.
Select Valiant Assault only when modeling that window; regular resistances do not apply.
The calculator does not simulate Courage, shield durability, or backlash.
mistakes: Using Hydro as the primary damage into 70–130% Hydro RES.
Ignoring Courage and assuming the boss stays in its regular phase.
Treating the full-HP shield as ordinary boss HP.
guide.higherDifficulty: Dire has 33,517,377 HP. Preserve energy for a high-uptime Electro window; the shield mechanic is not simulated.

bosses.name: Emperor of Fire and Iron: Ordained Conquest

phases.name: Molten Crown · Pyro horns active
phases.description: The source confirms a 150% all-RES increase while horns are active, but does not state final RES values; this window preserves manual RES.

bosses.note: Pyro is resisted at 60%. Hydro is useful against the Pyro horns and Sternshield Crabs. Exact horn-phase RES is not modeled because final values are unspecified.
mechanics: Twin Pyro horns have 64U Pyro and increase all RES by 150% while active. Destroying both horns deals 10% of boss max HP.
Sternshield Crabs have 12U Pyro and channel Pyro to the horns. Depleting their Pyro defeats them and makes them collide with the boss, removing 12U Pyro from its horns.
Damage to a crab contributes boss backlash equal to 60% of Hydro damage taken plus 10% of other damage taken, capped at 15% boss max HP. Up to three crabs can be present.
Destroying the horns interrupts Radiant Coronation.

traits.name: Molten Crown
traits.description: The Pyro horns boost the boss’s resistances. Destroy them when low enough to reach; destroying them deals a large hit and interrupts Radiant Coronation.

traits.name: Shield Bearers
traits.description: Sternshield Crabs channel Pyro into the horns. Depleting a crab’s Pyro makes it collide with the boss and damage the horns; damage to crabs also contributes capped boss backlash.

traits.name: Radiant Coronation
traits.description: The boss charges a wide attack. Destroying its horns interrupts the charge.

guide.overview: The Emperor has 60% Pyro RES outside its horn phase. Hydro application pressures Pyro gauges on horns and crabs; crab damage contributes to capped boss backlash.
strategy: Avoid Pyro as your only damage element.
Apply Hydro to horns and Sternshield Crabs; depleted crabs collide with the boss and weaken its horns.
Use the horn break to interrupt Radiant Coronation.
The active horn phase preserves manual RES because the source does not publish final numbers.
mistakes: Assuming an exact horn-phase RES value.
Using only Pyro damage into 60% Pyro RES.
Ignoring the Pyro gauges and scripted backlash.
guide.higherDifficulty: Dire HP is 14,042,886. Plan Hydro application around horns and crabs; the calculator excludes scripted horn/crab damage.

bosses.name: Radiant Moongecko: Entangled Fangs

phases.name: Dull Carapace / post shield
phases.description: The source lists 10% RES to all damage types during Dull Carapace; shield-break stun is brief.

bosses.note: Geo is resisted at 70% normally. The 9-layer Geo Ward takes blunt, Geo, or Overloaded hits; healing affected characters fully removes Radiant Cocoon.
mechanics: The Moongecko creates a 9-layer Geo shield with 4U per layer. Damage does not carry to the next layer. Geo, blunt attacks, and Overloaded can help break it.
During shield-breaking, 70% of Geo damage and 10% of other damage are reflected as boss self-damage, capped at 40% max HP. Breaking the shield briefly stuns it.
Four seconds after the stun, Radiant Cocoon reduces party HP by 15% max HP, damage dealt by 50%, healing received by 40%, and CRIT Rate by 100%; it also grants the boss 60% extra Geo RES.
Healing an affected character to full removes Cocoon. The first freed party member gains +15% CRIT Rate and +50% damage for 15 seconds; the boss loses its added Geo RES.

traits.name: Vagrant Reverberation
traits.description: The boss leaves a Moonstone Anchor and prepares a large attack. Damage the anchor, especially with Geo, to interrupt the charge and deal damage back to the boss.

traits.name: Unshakable Rock
traits.description: The ley-line disturbance strengthens the anchor’s multi-layer Geo Ward.

traits.name: Radiant Cocoon
traits.description: The boss applies damage, healing-received, and CRIT penalties while raising Geo RES. Heal an affected character to full to break the cocoon; the boss then loses the added Geo RES.

guide.overview: The normal state has 70% Geo RES, but shield-breaking damage becomes capped boss backlash. Blunt, Geo, or Overloaded hits help break the layers; heal the party to full after Cocoon.
strategy: Use Geo, blunt, or Overloaded hits against nine 4U shield layers; excess gauge does not carry between layers.
During shield break, 70% of Geo damage and 10% of other damage count toward capped backlash.
After the stun, heal affected teammates fully to remove Cocoon and its damage/CRIT penalties.
Use the 10% RES window only for Dull Carapace; normal Geo RES is 70%.
mistakes: Using Geo as the sole damage type during its 70% Geo RES state.
Assuming shield gauge spills into the next layer.
Leaving teammates below full HP after Cocoon.
guide.higherDifficulty: Dire HP is 20,950,072. Bring dependable healing and save damage for the shell-break window; layered gauge and backlash are not simulated.
